# Rose Empire — UK wholesale mattress protectors and pillows

Rose Empire is a Manchester manufacturer-direct B2B supplier of hotel-grade mattress protectors and cotton zip-bag goose feather and duck down pillows (not vacuum-packed). Trade buyers: hotels, care homes, retailers, guest houses, and distributors.

- [Home / request a trade quote](https://www.roseempire.co.uk/)

- [Wholesale pillows](https://www.roseempire.co.uk/wholesale-pillows.html)
- [Hotel bedding supply](https://www.roseempire.co.uk/hotels.html)
- [Care home bedding](https://www.roseempire.co.uk/care-homes.html)

Product facts:
- WQMP waterproof quilted — silent TPU, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, deep elasticated skirt to 40cm
- QMP quilted — non-waterproof, skirt to 35cm
- Terry waterproof — cotton loop pile, skirt to 35cm
- Goose / duck feather & down pillows — cotton zip-bag trade packs, standard 50×75cm pairs

Trade notes: protectors MOQ 20 per size (pillow-cover boxes 40); pillows trade £7–£8, 5 per box. UK warehouse stock in Manchester (5 Sagar Street, M8 8EU). Shipping £10/box mainland, £15 Scotland & Northern Ireland. Email info@roseempire.co.uk or call +44 7999 988450. Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.
